verdict.rationale: The Intuit developer platform documents a real, product-owned API surface that touches payroll: requests to add, modify or query workers' comp codes, plus a sandbox company and an llms.txt index. Nothing shows that the main UI capabilities are exposed programmatically, such as running payroll, tax filing, onboarding, time tracking, benefits or reports, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of core payroll runs and pay schedules, employee/HR/onboarding management, tax filing and reporting endpoints, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing UI parity, and independent confirmation of parity.
